messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'vela-enterprise-prod' GPU saturation detected — util >98% across nodes for 5m. Affected tenant: vela-corp (enterprise VPC, enterprise plan). Incident ID INC-20260317-042. Paging @oncall-erin.

oncall-erin: ack — joining now. Pulling dashboards and logs, creating a short incident channel.
sre-ben: oncall looped in. Looking at queue length & pod backpressure. Grafana shows sustained GPU queue spikes and KV cache miss rate increase. Any recent model rollouts?
eng-carla: not from infra side. No deploys in the last 24h. Suspect tenant-side traffic. Can we get top consumers on the pool? @platform-dave can you run top-tenants?
platform-dave: running `rictl pools describe vela-enterprise-prod --metrics top-tenants --window 5m` now. Output (trimmed):
```
vela-corp: 72% active sessions, 18.2k rps
edge-inc: 8%
sandbox-team: 7%
others: 13%
```
platform-dave: looks like vela-corp is responsible for bulk of traffic. No autoscaler events in the last 10m.
cs-olivia: FYI I just got a note from Vela's CS: they kicked off a large evaluation job 10m ago, expected run ~30–60m. They say they didn't request burst.
sre-ben: options: 1) enable burst capacity for the dedicated pool (fast but needs exec + billing), 2) evict non-enterprise low-priority workloads, 3) trigger autoscaler to add nodes (3–5m provisioning), 4) ask customer to throttle test. Which do we want now?
oncall-erin: we need fastest safe mitigation that minimizes customer-facing errors. If burst gets us under SLO in <2m, prefer that.
eng-carla: we have per-tenant burst support but it's gated. I can run the toggle for per-tenant burst. Command: `rictl burst enable --pool vela-enterprise-prod --tenant vela-corp --gpus 8 --duration 30m --reason "emergency eval"` (requires approver ack). Note: this bypasses standard billing notification.
cs-olivia: I'll ask Vela if they want us to enable burst. If they decline, we fallback to evicting non-critical sandbox jobs.
platform-dave: can also preemptively cordon a couple of nodes from low-priority workloads to move capacity. That is slightly more disruptive but doesn't cost extra.
sre-ben: I can initiate per-tenant burst if we get verbal ok from CS. @cs-olivia please confirm.
cs-olivia: Vela says "Please enable — we can't pause the run." They gave go-ahead and asked for a note on cost.
sre-ben: enabling now. `rictl burst enable --pool vela-enterprise-prod --tenant vela-corp --gpus 8 --duration 30m --initiator ben-sre`
incident-bot: ACTION_LOG: burst enable requested by ben-sre at ts=8301234589, awaiting audit.
sre-ben: done — API returned success. Propagating changes to scheduler. Watching metrics.
platform-dave: observed nodes scaling up, new GPU capacity attached. Updating routing cache.
sre-ben: monitoring: GPU util dropping on hot nodes from 98% -> 66% within 60s, queue length halved, p99 latency trending back to baseline.
oncall-erin: good. Any errors seen from customer requests?
cs-olivia: Vela confirms traffic is proceeding; they saw a transient 3% error increase during the initial surge but now back to normal. They asked for a billing estimate.
eng-carla: note for follow-up: we should record this under INC-20260317-042 with timeline and cost delta. I'll open a post-incident doc.
sre-ben: leaving increased monitoring on for 45m. Will rollback burst at 30m unless extended.
oncall-erin: thanks team — please put any follow-ups in the incident doc and tag me.
cs-olivia: customer asked for a recommendation: we should propose scheduled reserved burst or a short-lived dedicated job queue for large evaluations. I'll coordinate.
eng-carla: agreed — I'll draft an RFC for per-tenant burst automation (approval flow + auto-billing notification).
incident-bot: RESOLVED: burst achieved target; system reports healthy. Incident status: mitigated. Will keep open for postmortem.
sre-ben: marking as mitigated. Closing live page.
oncall-erin: great job. :thumbsup:
cs-olivia: Vela said "thanks, saved our evaluation run" — they want formal invoice details.
eng-carla: assigning follow-ups: CAR-1123 (postmortem), CAR-1124 (billing note to CS).
sre-ben: assigning myself to CAR-1123 for timeline extraction.
oncall-erin: I'll coordinate on-call writeup and update the incidents board.
cs-olivia: closing loop with customer. :white_check_mark:
